title: The projective line is a regular Noetherian one-dimensional scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\mathbf P^1_k=\operatorname{Proj}k[x_0,x_1]$ [def-sc-p1-standard]. Then $\mathbf P^1_k$ is a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), it is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], and its dimension [def-pc-dimension] is $1$.
